| CUSTOMER |
+----------+

+-------+
| ORDER |
+-------+

+-----------+
| LINE-ITEM |
+-----------+

+---------+
| ADDRESS |
+---------+

+---------+
| INVOICE |
+---------+

relations:
id(bytes=8)="CUSTOMER" ||--o{ id(bytes=5)="ORDER"     : places
id(bytes=5)="ORDER"    ||--|{ id(bytes=9)="LINE-ITEM" : contains
id(bytes=8)="CUSTOMER" ||--|{ id(bytes=7)="ADDRESS"   : invoiced at
id(bytes=8)="CUSTOMER" ||--|{ id(bytes=7)="ADDRESS"   : receives goods at
id(bytes=5)="ORDER"    ||--o{ id(bytes=7)="INVOICE"   : liable for
